source.product: OMPS Nadir Mapper L3 PCA SO2 total-column daily best-pixel grid, 0.25° (OMPS_NPP_NMSO2_PCA_L3_DAILY V1)

references.product: Press release on volcanic SO2 dispersal information for Taal Volcano, 30 June 2021

scaleNote: This is a coarse regional atmospheric SO2 column series, not a ground-level concentration, vog exposure, ashfall, or health measurement. For each day, the value is the mean of valid 0.25-degree best-pixel cells in a fixed 3x3 grid centered near Taal Volcano (about 83 km across); the monthly value is the mean of those daily regional means. Cells are accepted only when the product SO2 quality flag is 0 and cloud radiance fraction is between 0 and 0.2. These monthly means are event and plume context, not a monitor at the volcano or surrounding communities.

sampling.method: For each day with a NASA OMPS Nadir Mapper L3 granule, average valid SO2 column values over the fixed 3x3 grid-cell region nearest Taal; each cell is 0.25 degrees. The monthly value is the arithmetic mean of valid daily regional means.
sampling.qa: Use only cells with QualityFlags_SO2 == 0 (good best-pixel result), finite ColumnAmountSO2 within the product range -20 to 2000 DU, and CloudRadianceFraction from 0 to 0.2. The source product uses daily best-pixel retrievals.

period.aggregation: through the last completed calendar month
